title: Full Stack Engineer – Frontend Focus (m/f/d)
announcement: At Alpine Eagle, we’re building the future of counter-drone defence. We’re a fast-growing, international deep-tech company working at the intersection of aerospace engineering, defence systems, and machine learning. Our goal: create the world’s first swarm-based, airborne counter-drone system.   Modern conflicts show how quickly drones are reshaping the battlefield. Threats are rising, and today’s solutions aren’t keeping pace. We’re here to change that.   Alpine Eagle isn’t just a defence company. It’s a mission. Backed by an international team, strong funding, and a bold vision, we’re looking for people who want to shape the next generation of aerial security and build something that truly matters.   We are looking for a  Full Stack Engineer with a strong frontend focus and a proven background in human-machine interfaces for complex operational systems . You will turn complex sensor, agent, and mission data into an intuitive operational picture and effective control interfaces.     🎯 How you will make an impact: Develop high-performance frontend applications using  TypeScript and React   Take ownership of  frontend architecture  and establish reusable patterns for complex visualization and operator workflows   Develop intuitive and ergonomic operator workflows for  real-time, information-dense environments   Build interfaces for monitoring  system state, sensor information, agent activities, effector status, tracks, and mission data   Develop interactive  maps, GIS-based interfaces, and 2D/3D visualizations   Build real-time interfaces for monitoring and controlling multiple agents and system components   Contribute across the full stack, including  Python, Redis, APIs, and databases   Work closely with  systems, backend, and domain engineers  to translate operational concepts and system capabilities into effective operator workflows   Contribute to software architecture, code reviews, testing, and continuous improvement     ✅ What you need to be successful: Strong professional experience in  frontend or full-stack software engineering   Excellent  TypeScript and React  skills   Professional experience developing software for  cockpits, mission control, operator stations, HMI, or comparable complex operational systems   Strong understanding of  UX, ergonomics, and human-machine interaction   Experience designing interfaces for  real-time, information-dense environments  where situational awareness and efficient decision-making are critical   Experience with  real-time applications and distributed systems   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic engineering mindset   Ability to work effectively with systems, backend, and domain engineering teams   Ideally, also : Solid  Python  skills and experience working across the full stack   Experience with  Redis and databases   Experience with  GIS, mapping, and geospatial applications   Experience with  2D/3D graphics, WebGL, or graphics engines   Experience with autonomous systems, robotics, aerospace, defense,  C-UAS , or other mission-critical systems   Experience with sensor/effector integration or multi-agent systems   Fluent in  English ; German is a plus     At Alpine Eagle, we are committed to diversity and equal opportunity.
